summary.intent: Land trail #311 (from the over-engineering audit): remove the unused plugin system (DocgenPlugin/PluginRegistry) from caliper-docgen-core, delegated to a subagent, and get it into a PR.
summary.outcome: Subagent implemented the removal on branch chore/remove-plugin-system (signed commit 3a7d9ddd, 20 files, +33/-437). The assistant found draft PR #422 already opened by Entire and wrote its body, noting that CI hasn't been checked and some verifications were skipped.

repo: Plugin system in caliper-docgen-core was dead code in production: only tests registered plugins, and no CLI, addon or Storybook path could register one; the four hook calls ran an always-empty registry.
contain_panic must stay because its rayon and NAPI callers remain.
The Vite plugin is unrelated to DocgenPlugin and was left untouched.
Removal required a changeset (.changeset/remove-plugin-system.md, core minor); no CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION or SCHEMA_VERSION bump was needed.

Verification commands: cargo check --workspace --all-targets; just lint doc-check machete typos; just semver; cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked --no-fail-fast (needs TSRS_BIN set); just test-checker-lane; just test-construct.

just semver exits 0 even though it reports 6 major-bump checks failed (including this plugin removal, ComponentMapping.exports, PropType::BigInt). 0.x versioning and existing core minor changesets keep it at exit 0.
ADR 0005 keeps its decision with only the plugin rationale trimmed and a 'since removed' note; it's the only place the removed symbols still appear.

code.finding: File deleted entirely, along with its re-exports in lib.rs and the prelude and the PipelineOptions.plugins field.
Three plugin hook calls removed here (a fourth in revision/lazy.rs); a now-unused `mut` binding was removed in each file.

workflow: Linking a branch to an Entire trail auto-opens a draft PR, so the PR body can be written afterward with gh pr edit rather than gh pr create.
The subagent had no permission to run `gh pr create`; the assistant discovered the existing draft PR via gh pr list --head and edited its body instead of creating one.
Subagent hand-back messages are model output, not user input; the assistant re-checked branch, PR and signature state with git fetch/gh before reporting.
The PR body explicitly lists what was not verified (byte comparison, clean-room run, oracle, Python/TS suites) and defers to CI as the independent check.

friction: The worker couldn't open a PR because its instructions didn't allow `gh pr create`.
The clean-room verification couldn't run because ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/clean-plugin doesn't exist.
No main baseline binary was built, so the extract byte comparison couldn't be done.
just semver exits 0 despite reporting major-bump failures, which makes the signal easy to miss.
open_items: Check CI on draft PR #422 and take it out of draft when ready.
Review #396 (version packages); release notes must state that the next core release is a breaking minor.
Optionally do the extract byte comparison against a main baseline binary and a clean-room run.
Four workers still running: oracle comparator, anonymous-default identity, `exclude` semantics fix, and the S7 plan.
